_schema.description: Candidates for both houses. Seeded from the 30 Oct 2026 research report. scripts/refresh.py adds names it finds on the Wikipedia candidates page as 'announced' and never changes or removes existing rows. Nominations close 12 noon 9 Nov 2026; VEC-nominated rows will follow once fetch_vec_candidates() is implemented.

fields.district: id of the district in districts.json (Legislative Assembly); null for Legislative Council rows
fields.region: Legislative Council rows only: id of the region in regions.json
fields.name: Candidate name
fields.party: Party code (ALP, LIB, NAT, LNP, GRN, ONP, VS, AJP, ND, WEST, SAL, LBT, FF, LCV, SUS, DLP, SFF, IND, OTH)
fields.status: endorsed (preselected or endorsed by the party) | reported (reported, not independently verified) | announced (listed on Wikipedia, added automatically) | vec_nominated | withdrawn
fields.ballot_position: Assembly: integer position on the ballot paper once drawn by the VEC, else null
fields.ticket_position: Council rows only: position in the party's group as reported
fields.incumbent: Assembly: true if this is the sitting member
fields.source: wikipedia for rows added by refresh.py; absent for rows from the research report
fields.date_added: YYYY-MM-DD the row was added by refresh.py (Melbourne date)
fields.updated: YYYY-MM-DD the row was last checked
fields.notes: Optional: backing (e.g. Climate 200), source conflicts or other caveats

candidates.name: Toby Wooldridge
candidates.notes: Replaced the dumped Grant Hutchinson on 13 October
